It does not authenticate source rights or release dates, establish complete demand, train a model, calibrate uncertainty, expose an evaluation HTTP endpoint or justify real forecasts/recommendations.

Purely fictional, unverified release-aware backtest coverage threshold and conservative ranking gate. No calibrated intervals, real source permission, empirically validated demand forecasting, operational inference or WorldKernel.

Fictional retrospective trailing maximum-absolute-residual heuristic restricted to releases available at each origin. Not calibrated, no nominal interval guarantee, no source permission or empirical forecasting. Historical seasonal-naive forecasts are cached by target date within one evaluation only; separate cutoffs never reuse a cache. A fictional 7x21 exercise checks 28 forecast calls rather than repeated 154, without a wall-clock speedup claim. Differential regressions now compare 18 fictional mixed-release and missingness histories against execution without memoization, including exact 154-to-28 prediction call reduction on the complete toy fixture. No empirical performance, source authenticity or calibration guarantee. A release-aware rolling residual activation/expiration window is proposed to replace repeated calibration scans; it is subject to local differential regression and never adds source authentication or calibrated uncertainty.

Fictional adjacent-window eligibility and abstention counts at separate caller-declared, unverified publication cutoffs. No identification of selection bias, distribution shift of true demand, statistical significance, calibrated intervals or authorized source use.

Fictional conditional mean/median comparison over separately eligible retail positive-line subsets. Thresholded abstention, unauthenticated publication, no selection-bias correction or valid inference of actual distribution shift.

Fictional counterfactual bounds on two-window proxy mean differences with an explicit caller-chosen excluded-value ceiling, never a verified real bound, target imputation, selection-bias correction or production inference.

Bounded synthetic mathematical sweep of unverified caller-chosen excluded-target ceilings, with no actual target imputation, population shift identification, source authorization or production inference. Default disclosure now requires at least three eligible origins and 80% eligible dates in each window; any lower synthetic-research override is explicit and not a statistical guarantee. Two independently validated historical windows are now reused across every ceiling; pure scenario arithmetic preserves the legacy single-ceiling receipt and requires no extra source access.

In-memory metadata-only review packet that binds an existing staged CSV or UCI-shaped XLSX digest to bounded caller-supplied source, license, permission, privacy and requested-use references. Does NOT authenticate evidence, grant ingestion, permit source acquisition, verify historical publication or establish operational forecasting.

Offline verification of independently supplied Ed25519 reviewer public-key records, a versioned hash-chain head and denial/revocation/expiry for fictional source-review packets. Does not authenticate key provisioning, independent fresh log-head custody, reviewers' legal authority, publisher vintages, source permissions or data privacy clearance. Always ingestion_authorized=false and forecast_eligible=false; no signer, registry, real dataset ingestion, authorization endpoint or model enabled.

Process-memory-only bounded synchronized review log using atomic expected-version/head checks for independently signed source packet decisions, with terminal same-packet revocation, signature verification and explicit nonauthorization. No durable storage, independent log freshness, external reviewer key trust, signing service, identity/roles, cross-worker CAS, source rights or actual ingestion. A new instance loses its old head and cannot detect pre-restart rollback. Every receipt has ingestion_authorized=false and forecast_eligible=false.

Local SQLite schema v1 with bounded signed reviewer event histories, exact packet identity, transactional version/head CAS across independent interpreter connections, recovery after restart and fail-closed signed history checks. Review receipts always prohibit ingestion and forecasting. This is NOT tamper-proof, independently freshness-anchored, a protected reviewer identity/signing/key service, legally authorized dataset use, original data acquisition, a trusted clock or any production permission gate.

Offline Ed25519 domain-separated source-packet/review-head checkpoint verification with bounded expiry and caller-supplied minimum anchor sequence. Compares signed head and revision to one verified SQLite snapshot. Does NOT independently acquire current sequence, trusted signers, keys, legal rights or freshness; valid old signed checkpoint and old SQLite can replay if supplied minimum is stale. All receipts forbid ingestion and forecasting.

Offline verification of caller-supplied, bounded, linked Ed25519 witness receipts across review-head checkpoints, exact start/end fences and explicit dual-signed witness key rotation. Checks final signed checkpoint against SQLite; requires trust maps and current fences externally provisioned by a genuinely independent source, which MirrorMind does not implement. Cannot observe hidden forks, establish freshness, operate a signer, key custody, independent identity/legal review, authorized data ingestion or forecasting; receipt always sets permissions false.

Separate local SQLite schema for bounded source-packet signed publication history with externally pre-signed operator commands, witness and checkpoint role signature checks, explicit rotation, compare-and-swap and restart revalidation. Keys, operator identity/role provisioning, file access, clock and latest current head remain caller-configured, NOT independently attested. This is not a live independent witness, globally monotonic authority, key management service, real rights review or source ingestion. Every receipt has ingestion_authorized=false and forecast_eligible=false.

A separate local SQLite-backed signed operator-key enrollment/revocation ledger requires two independently configured administrator public keys for each change, checks exact IDs, permanent revoked-key tombstones, expiry, optimistic transaction CAS, stored signature replay, restart persistence. It does NOT authenticate administrators, operate protected private keys, independently attest the current head, integrate with checkpoint publication, guarantee atomic cross-database revocation, or grant real source rights. Every receipt reports publication_authorized=false, ingestion_authorized=false, forecast_eligible=false.

Opt-in new single-file SQLite gate for dual-admin operator policy and signed checkpoint publication. Local BEGIN IMMEDIATE validates current policy and full publication history atomically, refusing revoked/expired/unknown operators and stale heads. New integrated writes require an Ed25519 v2 operator signature over the exact policy revision/head (distinct from legacy v1 publication domain); v1 signed histories remain readable and standalone v1 rejects v2 submissions. Concurrency is serializable only for this local file; coherent old DB rollback, malicious file access, key custody, independently current authority, real operator identity, legal source rights and actual ingestion are NOT solved. Never returns publication_authorized, ingestion_authorized, or forecast_eligible true.

Offline generated-key Ed25519 verifier of a caller-supplied per-source-packet combined policy+publication head against one signed local SQLite snapshot and separately caller-pinned exact current fence sequence/digest. A coherent old backup mismatches a genuinely newer supplied fence, but stale trusted keys, old signed fence and matching old expected pins still pass. Does NOT operate a signer or independent latest-head authority, protect keys, establish identities or source rights, gate publication, authorize ingestion or serve forecasts. Every receipt leaves publication_authorized=false, ingestion_authorized=false and forecast_eligible=false.

Offline bounded 1-32 chained, per-source combined policy/publication Ed25519 fences with one authority and two distinct separately configured witness signatures per transition, exact caller-supplied anchor/current pins and final transactional local SQLite equality. A separately supplied fork classifier reports two authentic same-predecessor signed successors without selecting a winner. Hidden forks, stale pins, fraudulent witness clocks, real signer custody/identity, independent current-head service, production authorization, licensed ingestion and forecasts remain outside the experiment. Never grants publication, ingestion or forecast eligibility.

Opt-in separate local single-packet SQLite journal holding 1-32 complete dual-witness Ed25519 signed combined policy/publication fence transitions with strict packet/key marker, full replay and registry-local BEGIN IMMEDIATE CAS; terminal journal comparison to a separately stored governed publisher DB detects publisher-only old-backup restores while the journal stays intact. There is no cross-file transaction or independent remote current authority, secure key custody, verified identity, immutable backup/freshness, source license permission or production ingestion. Restoring BOTH files or a valid signed suffix truncation may pass. Receipts always have publication_authorized=false, ingestion_authorized=false, forecast_eligible=false.

Optional outbound-only HTTPS fixed-path reader generates a new OS-random challenge, checks bounded canonical JSON, a distinct configured Ed25519 service signer, exact source packet and current signed fence, 1-120 second UTC validity and compares the claimed current head against the separately signed local registry and governed SQLite snapshot. Uses system TLS, no redirect or proxy, 3-second timeout, 4096-byte cap. Tests use a fake transport: no remote head service is provided, reached or operated. The signer may freshly attest a false/stale head and clock/TLS/key-custody/independent currentness are not proven. No live publication admission, legal ingest rights or forecasts; all receipts report publication_authorized=false, ingestion_authorized=false, forecast_eligible=false.
